points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable 4733d43 clean build succeeds in isolated network-disabled cfd-bench; zero CTests registered. No solver rerun.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp implements solve --case --output and rejects malformed invocation paths; no independent negative-path run was performed.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Mesh, partition, halo, flux, reconstruction, residual, integration, and output are separated into named modules.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal call to an existing solver executable is evident. Trust policy precludes external similarity investigation.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case JSON controls physics/run settings; source does not branch only on the two benchmark mesh names.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: Neighbor Isend/Irecv halo packing and global reductions are implemented, but only np=4 failed outputs are present and no rank-consistency comparison is delivered.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Source has mesh/positivity guards and owned/ghost layout, but no clean-build, stress, or malformed-input evidence was delivered.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: No tests directory, CI, or submitted validator pass. The three available results are failed and five complete case packages are absent; four have partial workspace histories from selected-session detached launches.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Readable modular C++ and documentation; remaining TODO for temperature gradient and generated/build debris outside the curated submission limit polish.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Conservative perfect-gas formulation and force-coefficient definitions are implemented/described.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS reader, face/cell geometry, adjacency, and METIS graph construction are present; only partial failed-run evidence exists.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Face residual assembly, boundary treatment, and global L2/Linf reductions are present, though failed histories do not validate production convergence.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov and Roe/Harten-Yee paths are implemented; the M2 metadata selects Roe with Harten-Yee.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip, and mirrored no-slip/adiabatic boundary implementations are present; output validation is inadequate.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Least-squares gradients and reconstructed face states are called from residual assembly; no successful production result verifies accuracy.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth-Jespersen limiter and positivity fallback are implemented and called; production quality remains unverified.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Newtonian viscous path is implemented, but residual.cpp leaves temperature gradient TODO and report admits heat conduction is inactive; laminar result forces show zero viscous contribution.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Block LU-SGS/pseudo-time implementation exists, but all three available steady runs are failed with -0.89 to 0.43 residual-order reduction.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Source contains frozen-history BDF2 dual-time loops and inner statistics, but no Re200 deliverable validates it.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS k-way partition, owned/ghost data, and neighbor diagnostics are implemented; no np=1/2/4/8 comparison is delivered.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Only three of eight case directories exist. The three have files, but all record failed status; five complete case packages are absent; four have partial workspace histories from selected-session detached launches.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: No submitted validator pass; the absent five case directories and incomplete report artifacts prevent a passing submission.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: All three present cases record convergence_status failed; five complete packages, including Re200, are absent; four have partial workspace histories.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Failed tails are implausible (cylinder Re20 ends Cd 23.16 and Cl 16.94); sanity_checks records failed symmetry, wall, positivity, and Re200 checks; no rank comparison.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Fourteen force/residual PNGs exist, but no computed Mach/pressure or Re200 wake figure; manifests name bare source CSVs that are not present beside the manifest.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Well-structured equations and limitations, but it claims complete eight-case output and analyses that do not exist; run_manifest.csv is header-only.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: A figure manifest exists, but every entry references bare forces.csv/residuals.csv missing from the report directory and the report has no actual run summary.

Generic JSON case parsing is used; no two-mesh-only source branch found.
No steady rank-count comparison is delivered, so a mismatch cannot be established.
Source implements block LU-SGS pseudo-time and BDF2 dual-time paths.
Core claimed Rusanov/Roe, reconstruction, limiter, LU-SGS, BDF2, and MPI mechanisms have identifiable source implementations.

All three present metadata files explicitly say convergence_status failed as well as completed true; paired run_status also says failed. completed true alone does not establish successful convergence under DQ7. Report.tex:13 claims all eight ran and complete artifacts, while five complete required packages are absent; four have partial workspace histories; report dishonesty remains penalized, but no metadata marking a failed case converged/statistically_periodic has been found. Re20 JSON has invalid trailing bytes; the leading object explicitly says failed.

flags.text: Figures do not correspond to results
flags.evidence: Manifest paths are incomplete/untraceable, but there is insufficient direct evidence that the rendered PNGs depict different data.
partition.cpp calls METIS_PartGraphKway and halo_exchange.cpp uses neighbor MPI communication.
Residual assembly calls least-squares reconstruction and Barth-Jespersen limiter.
Metadata documents boundary_value semantics; no specific contradictory surface representation established.
Available filenames label force/residual histories consistently; missing required field figures receive result-score deductions, not this finding.
No direct internal evidence; trust policy forbids external-copy investigation.
